Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest

Class StoragePileGameTests

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest.StoragePileGameTests
public final class StoragePileGameTests extends Object
Storage pile behavior in a live level: deposits filling partial stacks before empty ones, growth when a pile fills, capability insertion addressing the specified slot, obstruction refusing growth, and settling consolidating, packing, and sorting.

    • capabilityInsertionAnswersForTheSlotItIsGiven

      public static void capabilityInsertionAnswersForTheSlotItIsGiven(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Internal Storage slot check: insert eight stone into local slot 20, reject dirt offered to that incompatible slot, then settle. Before settlement stone occupies slot 20; afterward it occupies slot 0. Simulation and caller-owned input are unchanged.

      To check manually, use slot-addressing automation to insert into an empty Storage slot, then observe the next settlement pack its contents toward the base. Precise pre-tick placement and dry-run results require an automation probe.

    • obstructionPreventsGrowthAndSimulationReportsNoRoom

      public static void obstructionPreventsGrowthAndSimulationReportsNoRoom(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      To reproduce: fill all 27 slots of a Storage block with full dirt stacks, allow height above one, and put solid stone directly above. Offer four stone through automation to first headroom slot 27. All four are refused and the obstruction remains. A simulated offer must report the same refusal without modifying input.

    • capabilityFromEveryBlockAddressesTheSamePile

      public static void capabilityFromEveryBlockAddressesTheSamePile(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Internal shared-view check: seed twelve stone in the base of two contiguous Storage blocks. Slot 0 and advertised slot count agree through adapters attached to either block.

      To reproduce visibly, make a permanent two-block Storage pile, leave twelve stone stored, and attach machines at different heights. Both access the same inventory and capacity.
